warnings: iamL (with igmL, ibbL, ibumL30) can slide 16.6 mm (-axis -y) until igmL touches rflfL; after 3.3 mm it comes out of the motor motL's output (the drive is lost). Only the friction of the cross fit holds it there. Add a bush or stop so it cannot travel that far.

igmL (on iamL) can slide 16.6 mm (-axis -y) until igmL touches rflfL; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaL and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

igmL (on iamL) can slide 16.6 mm (-axis -y) until igmL touches rflfL; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igbL and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

iamR (with igmR, ibbR, ibumR30) can slide 16.6 mm (+axis +y) until igmR touches rflfR; after 3.3 mm it comes out of the motor motR's output (the drive is lost). Only the friction of the cross fit holds it there. Add a bush or stop so it cannot travel that far.

igmR (on iamR) can slide 16.6 mm (+axis +y) until igmR touches rflfR; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with igaR and the drive stops. Only the friction of the cross fit holds it. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

spfL0, spfL1, spxfL0, spxfL1, wfL and 6 more parts hangs on the axle axfL, axfR alone (axis +y): it is free to rock about it while carrying wheels; gear gfL meshing outside it. Fine for a deliberate rocker or bogie; otherwise fix it with a second pin or a stud joint off that axis.

spfR0, spfR1, spxfR0, spxfR1, wfR and 6 more parts hangs on the axle axfL, axfR alone (axis +y): it is free to rock about it while carrying wheels; gear gfR meshing outside it. Fine for a deliberate rocker or bogie; otherwise fix it with a second pin or a stud joint off that axis.
